clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Chef Breanna feeds the Stormwind soldiers guarding the Redridge Mountains. She leads the town's kitchen and uses hearty local ingredients to keep the defenders on their feet.

Chef Breanna works from a restaurant house in northwestern Lakeshire with her assistants, Crystal Boughman and Gretchen Vogel. She is responsible for feeding the entire local battalion. Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs besiege the town, and Stormwind's understaffed garrison must stay strong. Her signature Redridge Goulash uses wild game and beasts from the surrounding ridges to feed the weary guards.
